translationRepairs: Arigh Fire, pacification commissioner of Hedong-Shanxi Circuit, was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat; his pacification commissionership remained as before.
Ali Huozhe, pacification commissioner of Hedong-Shanxi Circuit, was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat; his pacification commissionership remained as before.
阿裏火者 is a transliterated name Ali Huozhe; the English renders 火者 as a word "Fire".
The Imperial Stud was ordered not to be subordinate to the Xuanzheng Court.
The Imperial Stud was ordered not to be subordinate to the Xuanhui Court.
宣徽院 is the Xuanhui Court, not the Xuanzheng Court.
Bo Prefecture pacification commissioner Yang Hanying presented 1,000 rain felts; imperial son-in-law Tiebiechi presented 60 Rus rain felts, 50 knives, and 20 bows.
Bo Prefecture pacification commissioner Yang Hanying presented 1,000 rain felts; imperial son-in-law Tiebiechi presented 60 Luoluosi rain felts, 50 knives, and 20 bows.
羅羅斯 is the Luoluosi region, not Rus.
On gengshen day the censorate's attendant censor was promoted to rank 4a and the investigating censor to rank 5a; one additional Mongol bureau director was added at rank 5b.
On gengshen day the censorate's attendant censor was promoted to rank 4a and the secretary censor to rank 5a; one additional Mongol bureau director was added at rank 5b.
治書侍御史 is the secretary censor, not the investigating censor (監察御史).
Grand Preceptor Yulülu said, "Gathering the Ikires under Wozhe, 621 have now been obtained; they are ordered to garrison-farm together with Goryeo commoners; provisions should be granted them."
Grand Tutor Yulülu said, "Gathering the Ikires under Wozhe, 621 have now been obtained; they are ordered to garrison-farm together with Goryeo commoners; provisions should be granted them."
太傅 is Grand Tutor; Grand Preceptor renders 太師.
The Anhe Office was re-established, at rank six negative.
The Anhe Office was re-established, at rank 6b.
從六品 is rank 6b; "six negative" is a calque.
Following Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin's recommendation, associate administrator Wang Juji was rewarded with 500 ingots of notes for his ability in auditing revenues and grain.
Following Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabuding's recommendation, associate administrator Wang Juji was rewarded with 500 ingots of notes for his ability in auditing revenues and grain.
沙不丁 is rendered Shabuding elsewhere in the chapter; the final g is dropped here.
On dingyou day Grand Secretary Sariman and Hanlin academician ex officio Ulughadai presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Dingzong.
On dingyou day Grand Minister of Education Sariman and Hanlin academician ex officio Ulughadai presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Dingzong.
大司徒 is the Grand Minister of Education, not Grand Secretary.
On jihai day Yanci in Mizhou and Jiyang suffered great wind and hail, damaging crops; their rent was remitted.
On jihai day Yanci in Dizhou and Jiyang suffered great wind and hail, damaging crops; their rent was remitted.
棣州 is Dizhou, not Mizhou.
Memorial reported establishing a silver-field official, at rank seven negative.
Memorial reported establishing a silver-field official, at rank 7b.
從七品 is rank 7b; "seven negative" is a calque.

Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin, regarding granary officials who stole and embezzled money and grain, requested that following Song law they be tattooed and their wrists cut off; the Emperor said, "This is the Muslim law."

Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabuding, regarding granary officials who stole and embezzled money and grain, requested that following Song law they be tattooed and their wrists cut off; the Emperor said, "This is the Muslim law."
沙不丁 is rendered Shabuding elsewhere in the chapter.
Autumn, ninth month, on renyin day Hedong-Shanxi Circuit suffered famine; an edict ordered pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to roast grain and relieve them.
Autumn, ninth month, on renyin day Hedong-Shanxi Circuit suffered famine; an edict ordered pacification commissioner Ali Huozhe to roast grain and relieve them.
阿裏火者 is a transliterated name Ali Huozhe, not "Arigh Fire".
An edict ordered Hedong-Shanxi Circuit pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to issue 200,000 ingots of Datong note capital to purchase grain and relieve famine-stricken commoners.
An edict ordered Hedong-Shanxi Circuit pacification commissioner Ali Huozhe to issue 200,000 ingots of Datong note capital to purchase grain and relieve famine-stricken commoners.
阿裏火者 is a transliterated name Ali Huozhe, not "Arigh Fire".
Huguang province ordered the Eight Banners Cai Prefecture and Jun Prefecture ten-thousand-household offices and the Eight Banners Luodian pacification commission to join forces to suppress them.
Huguang province ordered the Bafan Cai Prefecture and Jun Prefecture ten-thousand-household offices and the Bafan Luodian pacification commission to join forces to suppress them.
八番 is the Bafan (Eight Fan) tribal region, not "Eight Banners".
On renxu day Grand Preceptor Saliman and Hanlin academician exempter Urudai presented the Veritable Records of Taizong.
On renxu day Grand Minister of Education Sariman and Hanlin academician exempter Ulughadai presented the Veritable Records of Taizong.
大司徒 is Grand Minister of Education; names harmonized with the chapter (撒裏蠻 Sariman, 兀魯帶 Ulughadai).
On bingyin day 6,000 horses in Liaoyang were requisitioned; the best were given to Chalih Temur's army.
On bingyin day 6,000 horses in Liaoyang were requisitioned; the best were given to Chalithemur's army.
阇裏鐵木兒 harmonized with the rendering Chalithemur used elsewhere in the chapter.

An edict ordered Prince Naimantai, Liaoyang branch secretariat pingzhang Xuechagan, and right cheng Hongchahu to select 10,000 Mongol troops to garrison in divisions at Shuangcheng and various cities of Posafu to guard against Qaidu's forces.

An edict ordered Prince Naimantai, Liaoyang branch secretariat pingzhang Xuechagan, and right vice chancellor Hongchahu to select 10,000 Mongol troops to garrison in divisions at Shuangcheng and various cities of Posafu to guard against Hedan's forces.
合丹 is Hedan (Qadan), not Qaidu (海都); 右丞 is right vice chancellor.
On bingxu day bandit Zhu Sanshiwu of Xianyou, Xinghua Circuit, gathered a mob and raided Qingshan; chiliarch Li Gang suppressed them.
On bingxu day bandit Zhu Sanshiwu of Xianyou, Xinghua Circuit, gathered a mob and raided Qingshan; myriarch Li Gang suppressed them.
萬戶 is a myriarch (ten-thousand-household commander), not a chiliarch.
Twelfth month, xinwei day: the Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Imperial Pasturage Temple.
Twelfth month, xinwei day: the Court of the Palace Guard was changed to the Court of the Imperial Stud.
衛尉院 is the Court of the Palace Guard and 太僕寺 the Court of the Imperial Stud; the English misnames both.
Second month, xinwei day: 10,000 gelded horses were granted to the troops under Yesudai'er.
Second month, xinwei day: 10,000 gelded horses were granted to the troops under Yesüderi.
也速帶兒 harmonized with the rendering Yesüderi used elsewhere in the chapter.
Yesudai'er and Commander Wang said, "By recent regulation, corvée purchase and forced purchase did not apply to military households; now they are treated the same as commoners."
Yesüderi and Commander Wang said, "By recent regulation, corvée purchase and forced purchase did not apply to military households; now they are treated the same as commoners."
也速帶兒 harmonized with the rendering Yesüderi used elsewhere in the chapter.
The Lanwei Bureau was again placed under the Xuanzheng Court.
The Lanwei Bureau was again placed under the Xuanhui Court.
宣徽院 is the Xuanhui Court, not the Xuanzheng Court.

On dingchou day Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was made right chancellor of the ministry secretariat, and Hanlin academician and chief director Buqumu was made grand councillor; an edict announced this throughout the realm.

On dingchou day Right Director of the Heir Apparent's Household Wanze was made right chancellor of the ministry secretariat, and Hanlin academician recipient of edicts Buqumu was made grand councillor; an edict announced this throughout the realm.
翰林學士承旨 is Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts; 承旨 is not "chief director".

Because the territory under the Qujing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was broad and popular sentiment was not yet settled, the Qujing and other places Pacification Commission and Military Ten-thousand-household Headquarters were established to garrison it; on xinsi day the Eight Tribes of Luodian in the Huguang branch secretariat was again placed under the Sichuan branch secretariat.

Because the territory under the Qujing Pacification Commission of Yunnan was broad and popular sentiment was not yet settled, the Qujing and other places Pacification Commission and Military Ten-thousand-household Headquarters were established to garrison it; on xinsi day the Bafan Luodian Pacification Office in the Huguang branch secretariat was again placed under the Sichuan branch secretariat.
八番羅甸司 is the Bafan Luodian pacification office; 司 is omitted in English.
On yimao day Jupiter transgressed the Ghost asterism.
On yiwei day Jupiter transgressed the Ghost asterism.
乙未 is yiwei, not yimao.
On yimao day the Huguang branch privy council was moved to administer from Ezhou.
On yiwei day the Huguang branch privy council was moved to administer from Ezhou.
乙未 is yiwei, not yimao.
On xinmao day Prince Timur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Suyuan and granted a seal.
On xinmao day Prince Temür Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince of Suyuan and granted a seal.
鐵木兒不花 harmonized with the rendering Temür used for 鐵木兒 elsewhere in the chapter.
On bingshen day 3,000 shi of rice was distributed to relieve famine victims in Kuolejisi.
On bingshen day 3,000 shi of rice was distributed to relieve famine victims among the people of Kuolejisi.
闊裏吉思 is a personal name (Körgis), not a place.

Associate administrator Lian Xishu was made right vice chancellor of the Huguang and other places branch secretariat and director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Chen Zhongda, Haibei and Hainan Circuit pacification commissioner and Qiongzhou pacification commissioner, was made director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Huguang branch secretariat left and right secretariat bureau director Buyansusi, Biebashili vice marshal, and Wang Xin vice marshal were all made vice directors of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; all were granted tiger tallies and led 2,200 men to campaign against the Li tribes; subordinates were all recruited and appointed by Zhongda.

Associate administrator Lian Xishu was made right vice chancellor of the Huguang and other places branch secretariat and director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Chen Zhongda, Haibei and Hainan Circuit pacification commissioner and Qiongzhou pacification commissioner, was made director of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; Huguang branch secretariat left and right secretariat bureau director Buyansusi, and Beshbalik vice marshal Wang Xin were all made vice directors of the Haibei and Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission; all were granted tiger tallies and led 2,200 men to campaign against the Li tribes; subordinates were all recruited and appointed by Zhongda.
別十八里 is the place Beshbalik modifying 副元帥王信; the English makes it a separate person.
On jiwei day Mendachen was again made censor-in-chief and directed mobile censorate affairs.
On jiwei day Mondar was again made censor-in-chief and directed mobile censorate affairs.
門答占 harmonized with the rendering Mondar used elsewhere in the chapter.

He Rongzu compiled ten matters — public regulations, governing the people, suppressing bandits, managing finances, and the like — into one book titled Regulations of the Zhiyuan Era; an order directed that it be carved on blocks and issued, for all offices to observe.

He Rongzu compiled ten matters — public regulations, governing the people, suppressing bandits, managing finances, and the like — into one book titled New Regulations of the Zhiyuan Era; an order directed that it be carved on blocks and issued, for all offices to observe.
至元新格 is the New Regulations of Zhiyuan; 新 is omitted.
Sixth month, dingmao new moon: Mongols returning to Muslim lands as merchants were forbidden.
Sixth month, dingmao new moon: Mongols going to Muslim lands as merchants were forbidden.
往 is going to, not returning to.
The Rare Treasures and Imperial Belt treasuries were added, of rank equivalent to fifth grade, each with one intendant, commissioner, and vice-commissioner.
The Rare Treasures and Imperial Belt treasuries were added, at rank 5b, each with one intendant, commissioner, and vice-commissioner.

In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingshen new moon, Qiela, associate administrator of Yunnan Province, said, "The capital site produces much gold; smelting offices could be established and nearby people made to refine it for submission to the state."

In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingshen new moon, Qiela, associate administrator of Yunnan Province, said, "Jiandu produces much gold; smelting offices could be established and nearby people made to refine it for submission to the state."
建都 is the place Jiandu, not "the capital site".
On jiyou day Chen Yiji, the Annam king's younger brother, right vice minister Chen Yan, and Zheng Ding's son Na Huai were all summoned to the capital.
On jiyou day Chen Yiji, the Jiaozhi king's younger brother, right vice chancellor Chen Yan, and Zheng Ding's son Na Huai were all summoned to the capital.
右丞 is right vice chancellor; 交趾 is Jiaozhi.
On guichou day seals were granted to the Shibi Cave pacification commission, Shibi garrison office, and Shiluo myriarch office; the pacification commission at rank 3c, the rest at rank 5.
On guichou day seals were granted to the Shibi Cave pacification commission, Shibi garrison office, and Shiluo chiliarch office; the pacification commission at rank 3b, the rest at rank 5.
從三品 is rank 3b; 千戶所 is a chiliarch office.
On yiyou day Masuhu and Asan were dispatched by post relay to Yunnan to capture Heihu.
On yiyou day Masuhu and Asan were dispatched by post relay to Yunnan to capture black tigers.
黑虎 here means black tigers (animals), not a person.
The Champa tributary state dispatched Mablakhanding to present golden script, a pagoda, black lions, foreign cloth, and medicinal materials.
The tributary state of Zhunian dispatched Mablakhanding to present golden script, a pagoda, black lions, foreign cloth, and medicinal materials.
咀喃 is Zhunian (the Chola), not Champa (占城).

At Liaoyang branch secretariat's request, because Nayan and Hede had rebelled in succession, an edict granted cattle, livestock, and farm implements to 30,000 attached Mongols and persons of Kaiyuan, Nanjing, and Shuidada.

At Liaoyang branch secretariat's request, because Nayan and Hedan had rebelled in succession, an edict granted cattle, livestock, and farm implements to 30,000 attached Mongols and persons of Kaiyuan, Nanjing, and Shuidada.
合丹 is Hedan; "Hede" is the name of a different prince (合帶) in this chapter.
Talahai, Zhang Huxin, and Vice Commissioner Cui were all sentenced to death for accepting bribes while auditing revenues and grain.
Talihai, Zhang Huxin, and Associate Prefect Cui were all sentenced to death for accepting bribes while auditing revenues and grain.
塔剌海 harmonized with Talihai used elsewhere; 同知 is associate prefect/vice administrator, a title.
In the ninth month, on xinchou day, grand councillor Maishuding was assigned to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs, and grand councillor Zaxiludin was restored in his place.

In the ninth month, on xinchou day, grand councillor Maishuding was assigned to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs, and grand councillor Zaxiludin was again made grand councillor to replace him.
復以咱喜魯丁平章政事代之: Zaxiludin was again appointed grand councillor to replace Maishuding, not "restored".
Sariman and Laoshou were both made grand steward and placed in charge of the Office of Imperial Sacrifices.
Sariman and Laoshou were both made Grand Minister of Education and placed in charge of the Office of Imperial Sacrifices.
大司徒 is the Grand Minister of Education, not grand steward.

Xuanzheng Court officials said, "Former Song Empress Dowager Quan and the Lord of Ying, mother and son, having become monk and nun, hold land of 360 qing; we request exemption from rent as in precedent."

Xuanzheng Court officials said, "Former Song Empress Dowager Quan and the Duke of Ying, mother and son, having become monk and nun, hold land of 360 qing; we request exemption from rent as in precedent."
瀛國公 is Duke of Ying, the title of the deposed Song emperor.
